1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Formula
3	  The specification language, as data.
4	
5	  A rule is an AST, not a Lean proposition, for three downstream reasons: the gate inspects it
6	  (which atoms, which operators, which parameters, any bare literal), the export serializes it for
7	  the tooling outside Lean, and the evaluator computes a three-valued verdict from it on a trace. Variables are strings bound by the grounding
8	  to tracks, and by the bounded quantifiers below to regions and devices of a kind.
9	
10	  Atoms, primitives and concepts are referenced BY NAME (the Lean definition names of Atoms.lean
11	  and Primitives.lean, `family_name`; a concept's `drv_<family>_<name>`), with arguments that are variables, enumeration values spelled as in
12	  ATOMS.md, or naturals. Semantics.lean dispatches the names; the doctor checks every name resolves.
13	
14	  A quantifier over road users ranges over every road user of the scene, the bound ones included;
15	  `same a b` is how a body excludes the subject from "another road user".
16	
17	  The bounded quantifiers take their kind as an `Arg`: a rule spells it (`.lit "intersection"`),
18	  a concept fills it from a literal formal on expansion. `rises` is an edge against the previous
19	  observation, not a frame: it says nothing about what happened between two observations.
20	
21	  `cond φ a b` selects between two quantities. A comparison over it is decided wherever both
22	  selections decide it alike, so an unobserved φ leaves a verdict open only where the choice
23	  matters (`elimCond`, applied before evaluation).
24	
25	  Deliberately absent: `next` (frame-relative and meaningless under irregular sampling), any
26	  numeric literal without a unit, any way to call an arbitrary Lean function.
27	-/
28	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Params
29	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Time
30	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.World
31	
32	namespace TrafficSpec
33	
34	/-- A value a formula variable can denote. -/
35	inductive Val
36	  | track (t : TrackId)
37	  | region (r : RegionId)
38	  | device (d : DeviceId)
39	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
40	
41	def Val.kind : Val → EntityKind
42	  | .track _ => .track
43	  | .region _ => .region
44	  | .device _ => .device
45	
46	/-- Variable bindings (the grounding's output; `Env` is the world's environment record). -/
47	structure Binding where
48	  binds : List (String × Val) := []
49	  deriving Repr, Inhabited
50	
51	namespace Binding
52	def lookup (e : Binding) (n : String) : Option Val := (e.binds.find? (·.1 == n)).map (·.2)
53	def bind (e : Binding) (n : String) (v : Val) : Binding := ⟨(n, v) :: e.binds.filter (·.1 != n)⟩
54	def track (e : Binding) (n : String) : Option TrackId :=
55	  match e.lookup n with | some (.track t) => some t | _ => none
56	def region (e : Binding) (n : String) : Option RegionId :=
57	  match e.lookup n with | some (.region r) => some r | _ => none
58	def device (e : Binding) (n : String) : Option DeviceId :=
59	  match e.lookup n with | some (.device d) => some d | _ => none
60	end Binding
61	
62	/-- An argument to an atom or a derived concept. -/
63	inductive Arg
64	  | var (name : String)      -- a bound variable
65	  | lit (value : String)     -- an enumeration value, spelled as in the ontology
66	  | nat (n : Nat)
67	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
68	
69	inductive CmpOp
70	  | lt | le | eq | ge | gt
71	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
72	
73	/-- What an aggregate over road users computes. -/
74	inductive AggOp
75	  | min | max | median | count
76	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
77	
78	def AggOp.toString : AggOp → String
79	  | .min => "min" | .max => "max" | .median => "median" | .count => "count"
80	instance : ToString AggOp := ⟨AggOp.toString⟩
81	
82	def CmpOp.apply : CmpOp → Q → Q → Bool
83	  | .lt, a, b => Q.lt a b
84	  | .le, a, b => Q.le a b
85	  | .eq, a, b => Q.eq a b
86	  | .ge, a, b => Q.ge a b
87	  | .gt, a, b => Q.gt a b
88	
89	mutual
90	  /-- A quantity. -/
91	  inductive Term
92	    | lit (q : Q) (unit : PUnit')                            -- written through a Units constructor
93	    | param (name : ParamName)                               -- a reading parameter
94	    | measure (atom : String) (args : List Arg)              -- a measured atom (Option Q or Option Nat)
95	    | quantity (concept : String) (args : List Arg) (params : List Term)   -- a Q-valued derived concept
96	    | distanceWhile (subject : String) (φ : Formula)         -- path length over which φ has held continuously
97	    | sinceRise (φ : Formula)                                -- time elapsed since φ last became true
98	    /-- The signed heading change (degrees, left positive) of `subject`, integrated from its yaw
99	        rate, since ψ last became true: from the latest observation at which ψ rose definitely (false
100	        at the observation before, true there), counted from zero at that observation. ψ turning false
101	        does not end it, nor does a stop; only the next definite rise of ψ starts it again. Unknown
102	        where no such rise is observed with ψ known at every observation since (an onset before the
103	        recording, or one an unknown value of ψ could hide), where an interval between consecutive
104	        observations from the one before the rise onwards is longer than `maxStep`, or where a yaw
105	        rate since the rise is missing. `maxStep` is a literal or a reading parameter, a time,
106	        strictly positive: the sampling standard of the integration, not a window and not a bound on
107	        how far back the onset may lie. -/
108	    | headingSince (subject : String) (maxStep : Term) (ψ : Formula)   -- the heading change of subject since ψ last became true
109	    | aggregate (op : AggOp) (var : String) (φ : Formula) (t : Term)   -- op of t over the road users var of the scene satisfying φ
110	    | add (a b : Term)
111	    | sub (a b : Term)
112	    | mul (a b : Term)
113	    /-- `a / b`, unknown wherever `b` is zero. Its divisor reads no measured atom: a measurement can
114	        be zero (a straight way's curvature, a halted road user's speed), so a bound on a ratio is
115	        written as a bound on a product (a ratio below a bound is the dividend below the bound
116	        times the divisor). -/
117	    | div (a b : Term)
118	    | neg (a : Term)
119	    | abs (a : Term)
120	    | cond (φ : Formula) (a b : Term)                        -- a where φ holds, b where it does not
121	  /-- A three-valued statement about the trace at an instant. -/
122	  inductive Formula
123	    | tt
124	    | ff
125	    | atom (name : String) (args : List Arg) (params : List Term)   -- a Boolean atom; params for tolerances
126	    | cmp (lhs : Term) (op : CmpOp) (rhs : Term)
127	    | asm (id : AsmId)
128	    | intent (id : IntId) (who target : Arg)                 -- the declaration current here: road user `who` intends `id` at region `target`
129	    | same (a b : Arg)                                        -- the two variables denote the same entity
130	    | not (φ : Formula)
131	    | and (φ ψ : Formula)
132	    | or (φ ψ : Formula)
133	    | implies (φ ψ : Formula)
134	    | always (φ : Formula)                                    -- from now to the end of the trace
135	    | eventually (φ : Formula)                                -- φ here or at some later observation, to the end of the trace
136	    | until (φ ψ : Formula)                                   -- strong until, future
137	    | since (φ ψ : Formula)                                   -- past mirror of until
138	    | holdsFor (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subject : String) (φ : Formula)   -- φ at every observation in the window behind
139	    | within (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subject : String) (φ : Formula)     -- φ at some observation in the window ahead
140	    | untilWithin (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subject : String) (φ ψ : Formula)   -- ψ at some observation in the window ahead, φ at every one before it
141	    | atLast (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subject : String) (ψ φ : Formula)   -- φ at the last observation in the window behind at which ψ held
142	    | count (edge : Formula) (sinceφ : Formula) (op : CmpOp) (n : Nat)   -- rising edges of `edge` since `sinceφ` became true (start of its latest run)
143	    | rises (φ : Formula)                                     -- φ here and not at the previous observation
144	    | definedWhen (pre φ : Formula)                           -- φ where `pre` holds; unknown (undefined) where it does not
145	    | derived (concept : String) (args : List Arg) (params : List Term)   -- a Boolean derived concept
146	    | rule (id : String) (map : List (String × String))       -- another rule complied with (not engaged counts as complied)
147	    | ruleApplies (id : String) (map : List (String × String)) -- another rule engaged (its binders' classes and applicability hold)
148	    | existsUser (var : String) (φ : Formula)                 -- some road user present in the scene
149	    | forallUser (var : String) (φ : Formula)
150	    | existsRegion (kind : Arg) (var : String) (φ : Formula)
151	    | forallRegion (kind : Arg) (var : String) (φ : Formula)
152	    | existsDevice (kind : Arg) (var : String) (φ : Formula)
153	    | forallDevice (kind : Arg) (var : String) (φ : Formula)
154	end
155	
156	deriving instance Repr for Term
157	deriving instance Repr for Formula
158	instance : Inhabited Formula := ⟨.tt⟩
159	instance : Inhabited Term := ⟨.lit Q.zero .count⟩
160	
161	namespace Formula
162	/-- The atom a window over a measure reads: the clock, or the subject's path length. -/
163	def measureAtom : Measure → String
164	  | .time => "kin_time"
165	  | .path => "kin_path_length"
166	
167	/-- The kind atom a quantifier with a literal kind reads (`existsRegion (.lit "lane")` reads
168	    `st_lane`); a variable kind is a concept's literal formal, read once the instance fills it. -/
169	def kindAtom (prefix_ : String) : Arg → List String
170	  | .lit k => [prefix_ ++ k]
171	  | _ => []
172	
173	-- The atom names a formula reads (for the gate, the manifest and the export): every leaf, the
174	-- measure of every window, and the kind of every quantifier with a literal kind.
175	mutual
176	  partial def termAtoms : Term → List String
177	    | .measure a _ => [a]
178	    | .quantity c _ ps => c :: (ps.flatMap termAtoms)
179	    | .distanceWhile _ φ => measureAtom .path :: atoms φ
180	    | .sinceRise φ => measureAtom .time :: atoms φ
181	    | .headingSince _ g ψ => "kin_yaw_rate" :: measureAtom .time :: (termAtoms g ++ atoms ψ)
182	    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => atoms φ ++ termAtoms t
183	    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termAtoms a ++ termAtoms b
184	    | .neg a | .abs a => termAtoms a
185	    | .cond φ a b => atoms φ ++ termAtoms a ++ termAtoms b
186	    | _ => []
187	  partial def atoms : Formula → List String
188	    | .atom n _ ps => n :: ps.flatMap termAtoms
189	    | .cmp l _ r => termAtoms l ++ termAtoms r
190	    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => atoms φ
191	    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => atoms φ ++ atoms ψ
192	    | .holdsFor m d _ φ | .within m d _ φ => measureAtom m :: termAtoms d ++ atoms φ
193	    | .untilWithin m d _ φ ψ => measureAtom m :: termAtoms d ++ atoms φ ++ atoms ψ
194	    | .atLast m d _ ψ φ => measureAtom m :: termAtoms d ++ atoms ψ ++ atoms φ
195	    | .count e s _ _ => atoms e ++ atoms s
196	    | .derived c _ ps => c :: ps.flatMap termAtoms
197	    | .existsRegion k _ φ | .forallRegion k _ φ => kindAtom "st_" k ++ atoms φ
198	    | .existsDevice k _ φ | .forallDevice k _ φ => kindAtom "dev_" k ++ atoms φ
199	    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => atoms φ
200	    | _ => []
201	end
202	
203	-- The reading parameters a formula names.
204	mutual
205	  partial def termParams : Term → List ParamName
206	    | .param n => [n]
207	    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termParams
208	    | .distanceWhile _ φ => params φ
209	    | .sinceRise φ => params φ
210	    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termParams g ++ params ψ
211	    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => params φ ++ termParams t
212	    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termParams a ++ termParams b
213	    | .neg a | .abs a => termParams a
214	    | .cond φ a b => params φ ++ termParams a ++ termParams b
215	    | _ => []
216	  partial def params : Formula → List ParamName
217	    | .atom _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termParams
218	    | .cmp l _ r => termParams l ++ termParams r
219	    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => params φ
220	    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => params φ ++ params ψ
221	    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termParams d ++ params φ
222	    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termParams d ++ params φ ++ params ψ
223	    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => termParams d ++ params ψ ++ params φ
224	    | .count e s _ _ => params e ++ params s
225	    | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termParams
226	    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
227	    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => params φ
228	    | _ => []
229	end
230	
231	-- The rules a formula composes, with each call's binder map, at any depth of formulas and terms.
232	mutual
233	  partial def termCompositions : Term → List (String × List (String × String))
234	    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termCompositions
235	    | .distanceWhile _ φ | .sinceRise φ => compositions φ
236	    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termCompositions g ++ compositions ψ
237	    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => compositions φ ++ termCompositions t
238	    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termCompositions a ++ termCompositions b
239	    | .neg a | .abs a => termCompositions a
240	    | .cond φ a b => compositions φ ++ termCompositions a ++ termCompositions b
241	    | _ => []
242	  partial def compositions : Formula → List (String × List (String × String))
243	    | .rule id map | .ruleApplies id map => [(id, map)]
244	    | .atom _ _ ps | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termCompositions
245	    | .cmp l _ r => termCompositions l ++ termCompositions r
246	    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => compositions φ
247	    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => compositions φ ++ compositions ψ
248	    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termCompositions d ++ compositions φ
249	    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termCompositions d ++ compositions φ ++ compositions ψ
250	    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => termCompositions d ++ compositions ψ ++ compositions φ
251	    | .count e s _ _ => compositions e ++ compositions s
252	    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
253	    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => compositions φ
254	    | _ => []
255	end
256	
257	/-- The rules a formula composes. -/
258	def composed (φ : Formula) : List String := (compositions φ).map (·.1)
259	
260	-- Numeric literals other than zero, with their units: what the gate holds against the node's
261	-- declared parameters (a magnitude belongs in the reading, not in a rule).
262	mutual
263	  partial def termLiterals : Term → List (Q × PUnit')
264	    | .lit q u => if Q.isZero q then [] else [(q, u)]
265	    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termLiterals
266	    | .distanceWhile _ φ => literals φ
267	    | .sinceRise φ => literals φ
268	    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termLiterals g ++ literals ψ
269	    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => literals φ ++ termLiterals t
270	    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termLiterals a ++ termLiterals b
271	    | .neg a | .abs a => termLiterals a
272	    | .cond φ a b => literals φ ++ termLiterals a ++ termLiterals b
273	    | _ => []
274	  partial def literals : Formula → List (Q × PUnit')
275	    | .atom _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termLiterals
276	    | .cmp l _ r => termLiterals l ++ termLiterals r
277	    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => literals φ
278	    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => literals φ ++ literals ψ
279	    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termLiterals d ++ literals φ
280	    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termLiterals d ++ literals φ ++ literals ψ
281	    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => termLiterals d ++ literals ψ ++ literals φ
282	    | .count e s _ _ => literals e ++ literals s
283	    | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termLiterals
284	    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
285	    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => literals φ
286	    | _ => []
287	end
288	
289	/-- A leaf is a subformula that reads the world or another rule: an atom, a comparison, an
290	    assumption, a derived concept or a composition. Leaves are numbered in traversal order. -/
291	def isLeaf : Formula → Bool
292	  | .atom .. | .cmp .. | .asm _ | .intent .. | .derived .. | .rule .. | .ruleApplies .. => true
293	  | _ => false
294	
295	/-- The leaves in traversal order, as a description each. -/
296	partial def leaves : Formula → List String
297	  | .atom n args _ => [s!"atom {n} {repr args}"]
298	  | .cmp l _ r => [s!"cmp {repr l} {repr r}"]
299	  | .asm id => [s!"asm {id}"]
300	  | .intent id who target => [s!"intent {id} {repr who} {repr target}"]
301	  | .derived n args _ => [s!"derived {n} {repr args}"]
302	  | .rule id _ => [s!"rule {id}"]
303	  | .ruleApplies id _ => [s!"ruleApplies {id}"]
304	  | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => leaves φ
305	  | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => leaves φ ++ leaves ψ
306	  | .holdsFor _ _ _ φ | .within _ _ _ φ => leaves φ
307	  | .untilWithin _ _ _ φ ψ => leaves φ ++ leaves ψ
308	  | .atLast _ _ _ ψ φ => leaves ψ ++ leaves φ
309	  | .count e s _ _ => leaves e ++ leaves s
310	  | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
311	  | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => leaves φ
312	  | _ => []
313	
314	def leafCount (φ : Formula) : Nat := (leaves φ).length
315	
316	/-- The formula with its `k`-th leaf (traversal order) replaced by `r`, and the number of leaves
317	    in the formula. A subformula whose leaves all precede or follow the `k`-th is returned as it is. -/
318	partial def replaceLeafAux (k : Nat) (r : Formula) : Formula → Formula × Nat
319	  | φ@(.atom ..) | φ@(.cmp ..) | φ@(.asm _) | φ@(.intent ..) | φ@(.derived ..) | φ@(.rule ..) | φ@(.ruleApplies ..) =>
320	    (if k = 0 then r else φ, 1)
321	  | .not φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.not φ', n)
322	  | .always φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.always φ', n)
323	  | .eventually φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.eventually φ', n)
324	  | .and φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.and φ' ψ', n)
325	  | .or φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.or φ' ψ', n)
326	  | .implies φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.implies φ' ψ', n)
327	  | .until φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.until φ' ψ', n)
328	  | .since φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.since φ' ψ', n)
329	  | .holdsFor m d s φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.holdsFor m d s φ', n)
330	  | .within m d s φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.within m d s φ', n)
331	  | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.untilWithin m d s φ' ψ', n)
332	  | .atLast m d s ψ φ => let (ψ', φ', n) := two k r ψ φ; (.atLast m d s ψ' φ', n)
333	  | .count e s op c => let (e', s', n) := two k r e s; (.count e' s' op c, n)
334	  | .rises φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.rises φ', n)
335	  | .definedWhen p φ => let (p', φ', n) := two k r p φ; (.definedWhen p' φ', n)
336	  | .existsRegion kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsRegion kd v φ', n)
337	  | .forallRegion kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.forallRegion kd v φ', n)
338	  | .existsDevice kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsDevice kd v φ', n)
339	  | .forallDevice kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.forallDevice kd v φ', n)
340	  | .existsUser v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsUser v φ', n)
341	  | .forallUser v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.forallUser v φ', n)
342	  | φ => (φ, 0)
343	where
344	  /-- Two subformulas in sequence: the right one is touched only when the target leaf lies in it. -/
345	  two (k : Nat) (r : Formula) (φ ψ : Formula) : Formula × Formula × Nat :=
346	    let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ
347	    if k < n then (φ', ψ, n + leafCount ψ)
348	    else let (ψ', m) := replaceLeafAux (k - n) r ψ; (φ', ψ', n + m)
349	
350	/-- The formula with its `k`-th leaf replaced by `r`. -/
351	def replaceLeaf (k : Nat) (r : Formula) (φ : Formula) : Formula := (replaceLeafAux k r φ).1
352	
353	-- The assumptions and the declared intentions a formula reads, at any depth of formulas and terms.
354	mutual
355	  partial def termDeclared : Term → List (Sum AsmId IntId)
356	    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termDeclared
357	    | .distanceWhile _ φ | .sinceRise φ => declared φ
358	    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termDeclared g ++ declared ψ
359	    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => declared φ ++ termDeclared t
360	    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termDeclared a ++ termDeclared b
361	    | .neg a | .abs a => termDeclared a
362	    | .cond φ a b => declared φ ++ termDeclared a ++ termDeclared b
363	    | _ => []
364	  partial def declared : Formula → List (Sum AsmId IntId)
365	    | .asm id => [.inl id]
366	    | .intent id _ _ => [.inr id]
367	    | .atom _ _ ps | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termDeclared
368	    | .cmp l _ r => termDeclared l ++ termDeclared r
369	    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => declared φ
370	    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => declared φ ++ declared ψ
371	    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termDeclared d ++ declared φ
372	    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termDeclared d ++ declared φ ++ declared ψ
373	    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => termDeclared d ++ declared ψ ++ declared φ
374	    | .count e s _ _ => declared e ++ declared s
375	    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
376	    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => declared φ
377	    | _ => []
378	end
379	
380	/-- The assumptions a formula reads. -/
381	def assumptions (φ : Formula) : List AsmId := (declared φ).filterMap fun | .inl a => some a | .inr _ => none
382	/-- The declared intentions a formula reads. -/
383	def intentions (φ : Formula) : List IntId := (declared φ).filterMap fun | .inr i => some i | .inl _ => none
384	
385	-- The aggregate ids a formula names (`ru_aggregate x "<definition id>::<term>"`), at any depth of
386	-- formulas and terms, for the reading check.
387	mutual
388	  partial def termAggregateIds : Term → List String
389	    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termAggregateIds
390	    | .distanceWhile _ φ | .sinceRise φ => aggregateIds φ
391	    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termAggregateIds g ++ aggregateIds ψ
392	    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => aggregateIds φ ++ termAggregateIds t
393	    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termAggregateIds a ++ termAggregateIds b
394	    | .neg a | .abs a => termAggregateIds a
395	    | .cond φ a b => aggregateIds φ ++ termAggregateIds a ++ termAggregateIds b
396	    | _ => []
397	  partial def aggregateIds : Formula → List String
398	    | .atom "ru_aggregate" [_, .lit w] ps => w :: ps.flatMap termAggregateIds
399	    | .atom _ _ ps | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termAggregateIds
400	    | .cmp l _ r => termAggregateIds l ++ termAggregateIds r
401	    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => aggregateIds φ
402	    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => aggregateIds φ ++ aggregateIds ψ
403	    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termAggregateIds d ++ aggregateIds φ
404	    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termAggregateIds d ++ aggregateIds φ ++ aggregateIds ψ
405	    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => termAggregateIds d ++ aggregateIds ψ ++ aggregateIds φ
406	    | .count e s _ _ => aggregateIds e ++ aggregateIds s
407	    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
408	    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => aggregateIds φ
409	    | _ => []
410	end
411	
412	/-- The first `cond` of a term reachable through arithmetic (not inside an aggregate or a window,
413	    whose body ranges over its own variable or instants), with the term rebuilt on each branch. -/
414	partial def splitCond : Term → Option (Formula × Term × Term)
415	  | .cond φ a b => some (φ, a, b)
416	  | .add x y => two .add x y
417	  | .sub x y => two .sub x y
418	  | .mul x y => two .mul x y
419	  | .div x y => two .div x y
420	  | .neg x => (splitCond x).map fun (φ, a, b) => (φ, .neg a, .neg b)
421	  | .abs x => (splitCond x).map fun (φ, a, b) => (φ, .abs a, .abs b)
422	  | _ => none
423	where
424	  two (k : Term → Term → Term) (x y : Term) : Option (Formula × Term × Term) :=
425	    match splitCond x with
426	    | some (φ, a, b) => some (φ, k a y, k b y)
427	    | none => (splitCond y).map fun (φ, a, b) => (φ, k x a, k x b)
428	
429	/-- Every comparison over a `cond` rewritten by cases: `(φ ∧ A) ∨ (¬φ ∧ B) ∨ (A ∧ B)`, with `A` and
430	    `B` the comparison on each branch. Where φ is decided this is the selected branch; where φ is
431	    unknown it is decided exactly when both branches decide it alike. -/
432	partial def elimCond : Formula → Formula
433	  | .cmp l op r =>
434	    match splitCond l, splitCond r with
435	    | some (φ, a, b), _ => cases φ (.cmp a op r) (.cmp b op r)
436	    | none, some (φ, a, b) => cases φ (.cmp l op a) (.cmp l op b)
437	    | none, none => .cmp l op r
438	  | .not φ => .not (elimCond φ)
439	  | .and φ ψ => .and (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
440	  | .or φ ψ => .or (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
441	  | .implies φ ψ => .implies (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
442	  | .always φ => .always (elimCond φ)
443	  | .eventually φ => .eventually (elimCond φ)
444	  | .until φ ψ => .until (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
445	  | .since φ ψ => .since (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
446	  | .holdsFor m d s φ => .holdsFor m d s (elimCond φ)
447	  | .within m d s φ => .within m d s (elimCond φ)
448	  | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => .untilWithin m d s (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
449	  | .atLast m d s ψ φ => .atLast m d s (elimCond ψ) (elimCond φ)
450	  | .count e s op n => .count (elimCond e) (elimCond s) op n
451	  | .rises φ => .rises (elimCond φ)
452	  | .definedWhen p φ => .definedWhen (elimCond p) (elimCond φ)
453	  | .existsUser v φ => .existsUser v (elimCond φ)
454	  | .forallUser v φ => .forallUser v (elimCond φ)
455	  | .existsRegion k v φ => .existsRegion k v (elimCond φ)
456	  | .forallRegion k v φ => .forallRegion k v (elimCond φ)
457	  | .existsDevice k v φ => .existsDevice k v (elimCond φ)
458	  | .forallDevice k v φ => .forallDevice k v (elimCond φ)
459	  | φ => φ
460	where
461	  cases (φ A B : Formula) : Formula :=
462	    let A := elimCond A; let B := elimCond B; let φ := elimCond φ
463	    .or (.or (.and φ A) (.and (.not φ) B)) (.and A B)
464	end Formula
465	
466	end TrafficSpec

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Formula
  The specification language, as data.

  A rule is an AST, not a Lean proposition, for three downstream reasons: the gate inspects it
  (which atoms, which operators, which parameters, any bare literal), the export serializes it for
  the tooling outside Lean, and the evaluator computes a three-valued verdict from it on a trace. Variables are strings bound by the grounding
  to tracks, and by the bounded quantifiers below to regions and devices of a kind.

  Atoms, primitives and concepts are referenced BY NAME (the Lean definition names of Atoms.lean
  and Primitives.lean, `family_name`; a concept's `drv_<family>_<name>`), with arguments that are variables, enumeration values spelled as in
  ATOMS.md, or naturals. Semantics.lean dispatches the names; the doctor checks every name resolves.

  A quantifier over road users ranges over every road user of the scene, the bound ones included;
  `same a b` is how a body excludes the subject from "another road user".

  The bounded quantifiers take their kind as an `Arg`: a rule spells it (`.lit "intersection"`),
  a concept fills it from a literal formal on expansion. `rises` is an edge against the previous
  observation, not a frame: it says nothing about what happened between two observations.

  `cond φ a b` selects between two quantities. A comparison over it is decided wherever both
  selections decide it alike, so an unobserved φ leaves a verdict open only where the choice
  matters (`elimCond`, applied before evaluation).

  Deliberately absent: `next` (frame-relative and meaningless under irregular sampling), any
  numeric literal without a unit, any way to call an arbitrary Lean function.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Params
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Time
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.World

namespace TrafficSpec

/-- A value a formula variable can denote. -/
inductive Val
  | track (t : TrackId)
  | region (r : RegionId)
  | device (d : DeviceId)
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

def Val.kind : Val → EntityKind
  | .track _ => .track
  | .region _ => .region
  | .device _ => .device

/-- Variable bindings (the grounding's output; `Env` is the world's environment record). -/
structure Binding where
  binds : List (String × Val) := []
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

namespace Binding
def lookup (e : Binding) (n : String) : Option Val := (e.binds.find? (·.1 == n)).map (·.2)
def bind (e : Binding) (n : String) (v : Val) : Binding := ⟨(n, v) :: e.binds.filter (·.1 != n)⟩
def track (e : Binding) (n : String) : Option TrackId :=
  match e.lookup n with | some (.track t) => some t | _ => none
def region (e : Binding) (n : String) : Option RegionId :=
  match e.lookup n with | some (.region r) => some r | _ => none
def device (e : Binding) (n : String) : Option DeviceId :=
  match e.lookup n with | some (.device d) => some d | _ => none
end Binding

/-- An argument to an atom or a derived concept. -/
inductive Arg
  | var (name : String)      -- a bound variable
  | lit (value : String)     -- an enumeration value, spelled as in the ontology
  | nat (n : Nat)
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

inductive CmpOp
  | lt | le | eq | ge | gt
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

/-- What an aggregate over road users computes. -/
inductive AggOp
  | min | max | median | count
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

def AggOp.toString : AggOp → String
  | .min => "min" | .max => "max" | .median => "median" | .count => "count"
instance : ToString AggOp := ⟨AggOp.toString⟩

def CmpOp.apply : CmpOp → Q → Q → Bool
  | .lt, a, b => Q.lt a b
  | .le, a, b => Q.le a b
  | .eq, a, b => Q.eq a b
  | .ge, a, b => Q.ge a b
  | .gt, a, b => Q.gt a b

mutual
  /-- A quantity. -/
  inductive Term
    | lit (q : Q) (unit : PUnit')                            -- written through a Units constructor
    | param (name : ParamName)                               -- a reading parameter
    | measure (atom : String) (args : List Arg)              -- a measured atom (Option Q or Option Nat)
    | quantity (concept : String) (args : List Arg) (params : List Term)   -- a Q-valued derived concept
    | distanceWhile (subject : String) (φ : Formula)         -- path length over which φ has held continuously
    | sinceRise (φ : Formula)                                -- time elapsed since φ last became true
    /-- The signed heading change (degrees, left positive) of `subject`, integrated from its yaw
        rate, since ψ last became true: from the latest observation at which ψ rose definitely (false
        at the observation before, true there), counted from zero at that observation. ψ turning false
        does not end it, nor does a stop; only the next definite rise of ψ starts it again. Unknown
        where no such rise is observed with ψ known at every observation since (an onset before the
        recording, or one an unknown value of ψ could hide), where an interval between consecutive
        observations from the one before the rise onwards is longer than `maxStep`, or where a yaw
        rate since the rise is missing. `maxStep` is a literal or a reading parameter, a time,
        strictly positive: the sampling standard of the integration, not a window and not a bound on
        how far back the onset may lie. -/
    | headingSince (subject : String) (maxStep : Term) (ψ : Formula)   -- the heading change of subject since ψ last became true
    | aggregate (op : AggOp) (var : String) (φ : Formula) (t : Term)   -- op of t over the road users var of the scene satisfying φ
    | add (a b : Term)
    | sub (a b : Term)
    | mul (a b : Term)
    /-- `a / b`, unknown wherever `b` is zero. Its divisor reads no measured atom: a measurement can
        be zero (a straight way's curvature, a halted road user's speed), so a bound on a ratio is
        written as a bound on a product (a ratio below a bound is the dividend below the bound
        times the divisor). -/
    | div (a b : Term)
    | neg (a : Term)
    | abs (a : Term)
    | cond (φ : Formula) (a b : Term)                        -- a where φ holds, b where it does not
  /-- A three-valued statement about the trace at an instant. -/
  inductive Formula
    | tt
    | ff
    | atom (name : String) (args : List Arg) (params : List Term)   -- a Boolean atom; params for tolerances
    | cmp (lhs : Term) (op : CmpOp) (rhs : Term)
    | asm (id : AsmId)
    | intent (id : IntId) (who target : Arg)                 -- the declaration current here: road user `who` intends `id` at region `target`
    | same (a b : Arg)                                        -- the two variables denote the same entity
    | not (φ : Formula)
    | and (φ ψ : Formula)
    | or (φ ψ : Formula)
    | implies (φ ψ : Formula)
    | always (φ : Formula)                                    -- from now to the end of the trace
    | eventually (φ : Formula)                                -- φ here or at some later observation, to the end of the trace
    | until (φ ψ : Formula)                                   -- strong until, future
    | since (φ ψ : Formula)                                   -- past mirror of until
    | holdsFor (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subject : String) (φ : Formula)   -- φ at every observation in the window behind
    | within (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subject : String) (φ : Formula)     -- φ at some observation in the window ahead
    | untilWithin (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subject : String) (φ ψ : Formula)   -- ψ at some observation in the window ahead, φ at every one before it
    | atLast (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subject : String) (ψ φ : Formula)   -- φ at the last observation in the window behind at which ψ held
    | count (edge : Formula) (sinceφ : Formula) (op : CmpOp) (n : Nat)   -- rising edges of `edge` since `sinceφ` became true (start of its latest run)
    | rises (φ : Formula)                                     -- φ here and not at the previous observation
    | definedWhen (pre φ : Formula)                           -- φ where `pre` holds; unknown (undefined) where it does not
    | derived (concept : String) (args : List Arg) (params : List Term)   -- a Boolean derived concept
    | rule (id : String) (map : List (String × String))       -- another rule complied with (not engaged counts as complied)
    | ruleApplies (id : String) (map : List (String × String)) -- another rule engaged (its binders' classes and applicability hold)
    | existsUser (var : String) (φ : Formula)                 -- some road user present in the scene
    | forallUser (var : String) (φ : Formula)
    | existsRegion (kind : Arg) (var : String) (φ : Formula)
    | forallRegion (kind : Arg) (var : String) (φ : Formula)
    | existsDevice (kind : Arg) (var : String) (φ : Formula)
    | forallDevice (kind : Arg) (var : String) (φ : Formula)
end

deriving instance Repr for Term
deriving instance Repr for Formula
instance : Inhabited Formula := ⟨.tt⟩
instance : Inhabited Term := ⟨.lit Q.zero .count⟩

namespace Formula
/-- The atom a window over a measure reads: the clock, or the subject's path length. -/
def measureAtom : Measure → String
  | .time => "kin_time"
  | .path => "kin_path_length"

/-- The kind atom a quantifier with a literal kind reads (`existsRegion (.lit "lane")` reads
    `st_lane`); a variable kind is a concept's literal formal, read once the instance fills it. -/
def kindAtom (prefix_ : String) : Arg → List String
  | .lit k => [prefix_ ++ k]
  | _ => []

-- The atom names a formula reads (for the gate, the manifest and the export): every leaf, the
-- measure of every window, and the kind of every quantifier with a literal kind.
mutual
  partial def termAtoms : Term → List String
    | .measure a _ => [a]
    | .quantity c _ ps => c :: (ps.flatMap termAtoms)
    | .distanceWhile _ φ => measureAtom .path :: atoms φ
    | .sinceRise φ => measureAtom .time :: atoms φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => "kin_yaw_rate" :: measureAtom .time :: (termAtoms g ++ atoms ψ)
    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => atoms φ ++ termAtoms t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termAtoms a ++ termAtoms b
    | .neg a | .abs a => termAtoms a
    | .cond φ a b => atoms φ ++ termAtoms a ++ termAtoms b
    | _ => []
  partial def atoms : Formula → List String
    | .atom n _ ps => n :: ps.flatMap termAtoms
    | .cmp l _ r => termAtoms l ++ termAtoms r
    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => atoms φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => atoms φ ++ atoms ψ
    | .holdsFor m d _ φ | .within m d _ φ => measureAtom m :: termAtoms d ++ atoms φ
    | .untilWithin m d _ φ ψ => measureAtom m :: termAtoms d ++ atoms φ ++ atoms ψ
    | .atLast m d _ ψ φ => measureAtom m :: termAtoms d ++ atoms ψ ++ atoms φ
    | .count e s _ _ => atoms e ++ atoms s
    | .derived c _ ps => c :: ps.flatMap termAtoms
    | .existsRegion k _ φ | .forallRegion k _ φ => kindAtom "st_" k ++ atoms φ
    | .existsDevice k _ φ | .forallDevice k _ φ => kindAtom "dev_" k ++ atoms φ
    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => atoms φ
    | _ => []
end

-- The reading parameters a formula names.
mutual
  partial def termParams : Term → List ParamName
    | .param n => [n]
    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termParams
    | .distanceWhile _ φ => params φ
    | .sinceRise φ => params φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termParams g ++ params ψ
    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => params φ ++ termParams t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termParams a ++ termParams b
    | .neg a | .abs a => termParams a
    | .cond φ a b => params φ ++ termParams a ++ termParams b
    | _ => []
  partial def params : Formula → List ParamName
    | .atom _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termParams
    | .cmp l _ r => termParams l ++ termParams r
    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => params φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => params φ ++ params ψ
    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termParams d ++ params φ
    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termParams d ++ params φ ++ params ψ
    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => termParams d ++ params ψ ++ params φ
    | .count e s _ _ => params e ++ params s
    | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termParams
    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => params φ
    | _ => []
end

-- The rules a formula composes, with each call's binder map, at any depth of formulas and terms.
mutual
  partial def termCompositions : Term → List (String × List (String × String))
    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termCompositions
    | .distanceWhile _ φ | .sinceRise φ => compositions φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termCompositions g ++ compositions ψ
    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => compositions φ ++ termCompositions t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termCompositions a ++ termCompositions b
    | .neg a | .abs a => termCompositions a
    | .cond φ a b => compositions φ ++ termCompositions a ++ termCompositions b
    | _ => []
  partial def compositions : Formula → List (String × List (String × String))
    | .rule id map | .ruleApplies id map => [(id, map)]
    | .atom _ _ ps | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termCompositions
    | .cmp l _ r => termCompositions l ++ termCompositions r
    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => compositions φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => compositions φ ++ compositions ψ
    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termCompositions d ++ compositions φ
    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termCompositions d ++ compositions φ ++ compositions ψ
    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => termCompositions d ++ compositions ψ ++ compositions φ
    | .count e s _ _ => compositions e ++ compositions s
    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => compositions φ
    | _ => []
end

/-- The rules a formula composes. -/
def composed (φ : Formula) : List String := (compositions φ).map (·.1)

-- Numeric literals other than zero, with their units: what the gate holds against the node's
-- declared parameters (a magnitude belongs in the reading, not in a rule).
mutual
  partial def termLiterals : Term → List (Q × PUnit')
    | .lit q u => if Q.isZero q then [] else [(q, u)]
    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termLiterals
    | .distanceWhile _ φ => literals φ
    | .sinceRise φ => literals φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termLiterals g ++ literals ψ
    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => literals φ ++ termLiterals t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termLiterals a ++ termLiterals b
    | .neg a | .abs a => termLiterals a
    | .cond φ a b => literals φ ++ termLiterals a ++ termLiterals b
    | _ => []
  partial def literals : Formula → List (Q × PUnit')
    | .atom _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termLiterals
    | .cmp l _ r => termLiterals l ++ termLiterals r
    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => literals φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => literals φ ++ literals ψ
    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termLiterals d ++ literals φ
    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termLiterals d ++ literals φ ++ literals ψ
    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => termLiterals d ++ literals ψ ++ literals φ
    | .count e s _ _ => literals e ++ literals s
    | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termLiterals
    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => literals φ
    | _ => []
end

/-- A leaf is a subformula that reads the world or another rule: an atom, a comparison, an
    assumption, a derived concept or a composition. Leaves are numbered in traversal order. -/
def isLeaf : Formula → Bool
  | .atom .. | .cmp .. | .asm _ | .intent .. | .derived .. | .rule .. | .ruleApplies .. => true
  | _ => false

/-- The leaves in traversal order, as a description each. -/
partial def leaves : Formula → List String
  | .atom n args _ => [s!"atom {n} {repr args}"]
  | .cmp l _ r => [s!"cmp {repr l} {repr r}"]
  | .asm id => [s!"asm {id}"]
  | .intent id who target => [s!"intent {id} {repr who} {repr target}"]
  | .derived n args _ => [s!"derived {n} {repr args}"]
  | .rule id _ => [s!"rule {id}"]
  | .ruleApplies id _ => [s!"ruleApplies {id}"]
  | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => leaves φ
  | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => leaves φ ++ leaves ψ
  | .holdsFor _ _ _ φ | .within _ _ _ φ => leaves φ
  | .untilWithin _ _ _ φ ψ => leaves φ ++ leaves ψ
  | .atLast _ _ _ ψ φ => leaves ψ ++ leaves φ
  | .count e s _ _ => leaves e ++ leaves s
  | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
  | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => leaves φ
  | _ => []

def leafCount (φ : Formula) : Nat := (leaves φ).length

/-- The formula with its `k`-th leaf (traversal order) replaced by `r`, and the number of leaves
    in the formula. A subformula whose leaves all precede or follow the `k`-th is returned as it is. -/
partial def replaceLeafAux (k : Nat) (r : Formula) : Formula → Formula × Nat
  | φ@(.atom ..) | φ@(.cmp ..) | φ@(.asm _) | φ@(.intent ..) | φ@(.derived ..) | φ@(.rule ..) | φ@(.ruleApplies ..) =>
    (if k = 0 then r else φ, 1)
  | .not φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.not φ', n)
  | .always φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.always φ', n)
  | .eventually φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.eventually φ', n)
  | .and φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.and φ' ψ', n)
  | .or φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.or φ' ψ', n)
  | .implies φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.implies φ' ψ', n)
  | .until φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.until φ' ψ', n)
  | .since φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.since φ' ψ', n)
  | .holdsFor m d s φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.holdsFor m d s φ', n)
  | .within m d s φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.within m d s φ', n)
  | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.untilWithin m d s φ' ψ', n)
  | .atLast m d s ψ φ => let (ψ', φ', n) := two k r ψ φ; (.atLast m d s ψ' φ', n)
  | .count e s op c => let (e', s', n) := two k r e s; (.count e' s' op c, n)
  | .rises φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.rises φ', n)
  | .definedWhen p φ => let (p', φ', n) := two k r p φ; (.definedWhen p' φ', n)
  | .existsRegion kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsRegion kd v φ', n)
  | .forallRegion kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.forallRegion kd v φ', n)
  | .existsDevice kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsDevice kd v φ', n)
  | .forallDevice kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.forallDevice kd v φ', n)
  | .existsUser v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsUser v φ', n)
  | .forallUser v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.forallUser v φ', n)
  | φ => (φ, 0)
where
  /-- Two subformulas in sequence: the right one is touched only when the target leaf lies in it. -/
  two (k : Nat) (r : Formula) (φ ψ : Formula) : Formula × Formula × Nat :=
    let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ
    if k < n then (φ', ψ, n + leafCount ψ)
    else let (ψ', m) := replaceLeafAux (k - n) r ψ; (φ', ψ', n + m)

/-- The formula with its `k`-th leaf replaced by `r`. -/
def replaceLeaf (k : Nat) (r : Formula) (φ : Formula) : Formula := (replaceLeafAux k r φ).1

-- The assumptions and the declared intentions a formula reads, at any depth of formulas and terms.
mutual
  partial def termDeclared : Term → List (Sum AsmId IntId)
    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termDeclared
    | .distanceWhile _ φ | .sinceRise φ => declared φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termDeclared g ++ declared ψ
    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => declared φ ++ termDeclared t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termDeclared a ++ termDeclared b
    | .neg a | .abs a => termDeclared a
    | .cond φ a b => declared φ ++ termDeclared a ++ termDeclared b
    | _ => []
  partial def declared : Formula → List (Sum AsmId IntId)
    | .asm id => [.inl id]
    | .intent id _ _ => [.inr id]
    | .atom _ _ ps | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termDeclared
    | .cmp l _ r => termDeclared l ++ termDeclared r
    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => declared φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => declared φ ++ declared ψ
    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termDeclared d ++ declared φ
    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termDeclared d ++ declared φ ++ declared ψ
    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => termDeclared d ++ declared ψ ++ declared φ
    | .count e s _ _ => declared e ++ declared s
    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => declared φ
    | _ => []
end

/-- The assumptions a formula reads. -/
def assumptions (φ : Formula) : List AsmId := (declared φ).filterMap fun | .inl a => some a | .inr _ => none
/-- The declared intentions a formula reads. -/
def intentions (φ : Formula) : List IntId := (declared φ).filterMap fun | .inr i => some i | .inl _ => none

-- The aggregate ids a formula names (`ru_aggregate x "<definition id>::<term>"`), at any depth of
-- formulas and terms, for the reading check.
mutual
  partial def termAggregateIds : Term → List String
    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termAggregateIds
    | .distanceWhile _ φ | .sinceRise φ => aggregateIds φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termAggregateIds g ++ aggregateIds ψ
    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => aggregateIds φ ++ termAggregateIds t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termAggregateIds a ++ termAggregateIds b
    | .neg a | .abs a => termAggregateIds a
    | .cond φ a b => aggregateIds φ ++ termAggregateIds a ++ termAggregateIds b
    | _ => []
  partial def aggregateIds : Formula → List String
    | .atom "ru_aggregate" [_, .lit w] ps => w :: ps.flatMap termAggregateIds
    | .atom _ _ ps | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termAggregateIds
    | .cmp l _ r => termAggregateIds l ++ termAggregateIds r
    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => aggregateIds φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => aggregateIds φ ++ aggregateIds ψ
    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termAggregateIds d ++ aggregateIds φ
    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termAggregateIds d ++ aggregateIds φ ++ aggregateIds ψ
    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => termAggregateIds d ++ aggregateIds ψ ++ aggregateIds φ
    | .count e s _ _ => aggregateIds e ++ aggregateIds s
    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => aggregateIds φ
    | _ => []
end

/-- The first `cond` of a term reachable through arithmetic (not inside an aggregate or a window,
    whose body ranges over its own variable or instants), with the term rebuilt on each branch. -/
partial def splitCond : Term → Option (Formula × Term × Term)
  | .cond φ a b => some (φ, a, b)
  | .add x y => two .add x y
  | .sub x y => two .sub x y
  | .mul x y => two .mul x y
  | .div x y => two .div x y
  | .neg x => (splitCond x).map fun (φ, a, b) => (φ, .neg a, .neg b)
  | .abs x => (splitCond x).map fun (φ, a, b) => (φ, .abs a, .abs b)
  | _ => none
where
  two (k : Term → Term → Term) (x y : Term) : Option (Formula × Term × Term) :=
    match splitCond x with
    | some (φ, a, b) => some (φ, k a y, k b y)
    | none => (splitCond y).map fun (φ, a, b) => (φ, k x a, k x b)

/-- Every comparison over a `cond` rewritten by cases: `(φ ∧ A) ∨ (¬φ ∧ B) ∨ (A ∧ B)`, with `A` and
    `B` the comparison on each branch. Where φ is decided this is the selected branch; where φ is
    unknown it is decided exactly when both branches decide it alike. -/
partial def elimCond : Formula → Formula
  | .cmp l op r =>
    match splitCond l, splitCond r with
    | some (φ, a, b), _ => cases φ (.cmp a op r) (.cmp b op r)
    | none, some (φ, a, b) => cases φ (.cmp l op a) (.cmp l op b)
    | none, none => .cmp l op r
  | .not φ => .not (elimCond φ)
  | .and φ ψ => .and (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
  | .or φ ψ => .or (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
  | .implies φ ψ => .implies (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
  | .always φ => .always (elimCond φ)
  | .eventually φ => .eventually (elimCond φ)
  | .until φ ψ => .until (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
  | .since φ ψ => .since (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
  | .holdsFor m d s φ => .holdsFor m d s (elimCond φ)
  | .within m d s φ => .within m d s (elimCond φ)
  | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => .untilWithin m d s (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
  | .atLast m d s ψ φ => .atLast m d s (elimCond ψ) (elimCond φ)
  | .count e s op n => .count (elimCond e) (elimCond s) op n
  | .rises φ => .rises (elimCond φ)
  | .definedWhen p φ => .definedWhen (elimCond p) (elimCond φ)
  | .existsUser v φ => .existsUser v (elimCond φ)
  | .forallUser v φ => .forallUser v (elimCond φ)
  | .existsRegion k v φ => .existsRegion k v (elimCond φ)
  | .forallRegion k v φ => .forallRegion k v (elimCond φ)
  | .existsDevice k v φ => .existsDevice k v (elimCond φ)
  | .forallDevice k v φ => .forallDevice k v (elimCond φ)
  | φ => φ
where
  cases (φ A B : Formula) : Formula :=
    let A := elimCond A; let B := elimCond B; let φ := elimCond φ
    .or (.or (.and φ A) (.and (.not φ) B)) (.and A B)
end Formula

end TrafficSpec

/-

  `evalAll` evaluates a formula bottom-up, each subformula once for the whole trace, so a formula
  costs O(|φ| · n log n) per binding: atoms map a scene function over the instants, the temporal

  enumeration value or a variable of the wrong sort is `unknown (malformed …)`. The static check
  (RuleEval.check) finds every such defect from the syntax before any trace is read, so a checked
  rule reports at evaluation time only source absence, truncation, sampling gaps, undefined
  concept preconditions, division by zero and unknown compositions.

  Finite-trace policy — unobserved is unknown, never compliance:
  - `holdsFor` needs its whole window observed at adequate density, else unknown;
  - `within`/`untilWithin` are true on a witness, false only when the window is covered;
  - `eventually`/`until` carry the unobserved future, `since` the unobserved past, and `always`
    the unobserved future as unknown: on a finite trace `always φ` is false or unknown, never true.
    A rule's obligation is written for an instant; the sweep over instants (Grounding) is the
    "always".

  Rule composition is a callback, because the library of rules is defined above this file.

import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Primitives
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Intentions

namespace Semantics

open Primitives (DArg)
open Temporal

    evaluate another rule's obligation (`rule id map`) under a variable map, per instant. -/
structure SemCtx where
  d : Primitives.Ctx
  β : Binding := {}
  /-- Another rule's verdict per instant under a variable map: complied-with when `engaged` is
      false, engaged (classes and applicability) when true. -/
  compose : String → List (String × String) → Binding → Bool → Array R :=
    fun _ _ _ _ => #[]

namespace SemCtx
def n (c : SemCtx) : Nat := c.d.n
def scenes (c : SemCtx) : Array Scene := c.d.scenes
def bindVar (c : SemCtx) (v : String) (x : Val) : SemCtx := { c with β := c.β.bind v x }
def mk' (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) (β : Binding := {}) : SemCtx := { d := Primitives.Ctx.mk' τ ρ, β := β }

61	def resolve (β : Binding) : Arg → Except UnknownReason DArg
62	  | .var v =>
63	    match β.lookup v with
64	    | some (.track t) => .ok (.v t)
65	    | some (.region r) => .ok (.v r)
66	    | some (.device d) => .ok (.v d)
67	    | none => .error (.unboundVariable v)
68	  | .lit s => .ok (.s s)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def resolve (β : Binding) : Arg → Except UnknownReason DArg
  | .var v =>
    match β.lookup v with
    | some (.track t) => .ok (.v t)
    | some (.region r) => .ok (.v r)
    | some (.device d) => .ok (.v d)
    | none => .error (.unboundVariable v)
  | .lit s => .ok (.s s)
  | .nat k => .ok (.n k)

def resolveAll (β : Binding) (args : List Arg) : Except UnknownReason (List DArg) := args.mapM (resolve β)

private def ent (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason Nat :=
  match a with | .v t => .ok t | .n k => .ok k | .s _ => .error (.malformed "entity expected")
private def lit (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason String :=
  match a with | .s s => .ok s | _ => .error (.malformed "literal expected")
private def enumLit {α : Type} (ofString : String → Option α) (a : DArg) : Except UnknownReason α := do
  let s ← lit a
  match ofString s with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.malformed s)

private def b (o : Option Bool) (name : String) : R := R.ofOption o (.absentAtom name)
private def eqEnum {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (o : Option α) (v : α) (name : String) : R :=
  b (o.map (· == v)) name
private def q (o : Option Q) (name : String) : QR :=
  match o with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
private def qn (o : Option Nat) (name : String) : QR :=
  match o with | some v => .ok (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat v)) | none => .error (.absentAtom name)
private def qz (o : Option Int) (name : String) : QR :=
  match o with | some v => .ok (Q.ofInt v) | none => .error (.absentAtom name)

def unknownAtom (n : String) : UnknownReason := .malformed s!"atom {n}"
def arity (n : String) : UnknownReason := .malformed s!"arity {n}"

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Boolean atoms by name, on one scene. Class atoms (`ru_*`, `st_*`, `dev_*` kinds) are dispatched
-- through the generated codecs, so the table cannot drift from ATOMS.md; attribute atoms are listed.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def evalAtomE (s : Scene) (name : String) (args : List DArg) (ps : List Q) : Except UnknownReason R := do
  match name, args with
  -- road users
  | "ru_subject", [x] => pure (b (ru_subject s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_aggregate", [_, .s w] => .error (.parameterMissing s!"aggregate:{w}")   -- resolved with the reading in `evalAll`
  | "ru_rider_posture", [x, f] =>
    match f with
    | .s "on_seat" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_on_seat s (← ent x)) name)
    | .s "standing_on_deck" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_standing_on_deck s (← ent x)) name)
    | .s "holding_another_vehicle" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_holding_another_vehicle s (← ent x)) name)
    | .s "stunt" => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_stunt s (← ent x)) name)
    | _ => .error (.malformed "posture field")
  | "ru_rider_posture_on_seat", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_on_seat s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_rider_posture_standing_on_deck", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_standing_on_deck s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_rider_posture_holding_another_vehicle", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_holding_another_vehicle s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_rider_posture_stunt", [x] => pure (b (ru_rider_posture_stunt s (← ent x)) name)
  | "ru_emergency_vehicle_kind", [x, k] => pure (eqEnum (ru_emergency_vehicle_kind s (← ent x)) (← enumLit EmergencyKind.ofString k) name)
  | "ru_official_vehicle_kind", [x, k] => pure (eqEnum (ru_official_vehicle_kind s (← ent x)) (← enumLit OfficialKind.ofString k) name)
  -- control state
  | "kin_engine_running", [x] => pure (b (kin_engine_running s (← ent x)) name)
  | "kin_parking_brake", [x] => pure (b (kin_parking_brake s (← ent x)) name)
  -- structure attributes
  | "st_road_edge_paved", [r] => pure (b (st_road_edge_paved s (← ent r)) name)
  | "st_shoulder_paved", [r] => pure (b (st_shoulder_paved s (← ent r)) name)
  | "st_median_or_divider_opening", [r] => pure (b (st_median_or_divider_opening s (← ent r)) name)
  | "st_crosswalk_marked", [r] => pure (b (st_crosswalk_marked s (← ent r)) name)
  | "st_reserved_lane_class", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_reserved_lane_class s (← ent r)) (← enumLit ReservedClass.ofString k) name)
  | "st_turn_lane_side", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_turn_lane_side s (← ent r)) (← enumLit TurnSide.ofString k) name)
  | "st_parking_space_designation", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_parking_space_designation s (← ent r)) (← enumLit ParkingDesignation.ofString k) name)
  | "st_curb_zone_kind", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_curb_zone_kind s (← ent r)) (← enumLit CurbZoneKind.ofString k) name)
  | "st_curb_zone_colour", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_curb_zone_colour s (← ent r)) (← enumLit CurbColour.ofString k) name)
  | "st_obstruction_kind", [r, k] => pure (eqEnum (st_obstruction_kind s (← ent r)) (← enumLit ObstructionKind.ofString k) name)
  | "st_lane_adjacency", [r, sd, r'] =>
    match sd with
    | .s "left" => pure (b (st_lane_left_of s (← ent r) (← ent r')) name)
    | .s "right" => pure (b (st_lane_right_of s (← ent r) (← ent r')) name)
    | _ => .error (.malformed "side")
  | "st_lane_adjacency_left", [r, r'] => pure (b (st_lane_left_of s (← ent r) (← ent r')) name)
  | "st_lane_adjacency_right", [r, r'] => pure (b (st_lane_right_of s (← ent r) (← ent r')) name)
  | "st_lane_connectivity", [r, r'] => pure (b ((st_lane_connectivity s (← ent r)).map (·.contains (← ent r'))) name)
  | "st_lane_enters", [r, i] => pure (b ((st_lane_enters s (← ent r)).map (· == (← ent i))) name)
  | "st_on_way", [r, w] => pure (b ((st_on_way s (← ent r)).map (·.contains (← ent w))) name)
  | "st_entrance_of", [l, a] => pure (b (st_entrance_of s (← ent l) (← ent a)) name)
  | "st_lane_marking", [r, sd, t] =>
    match sd with
    | .s "left" => pure (eqEnum ((st_lane_marking_left s (← ent r)).map (·.1)) (← enumLit MarkingType.ofString t) name)
    | .s "right" => pure (eqEnum ((st_lane_marking_right s (← ent r)).map (·.1)) (← enumLit MarkingType.ofString t) name)
    | _ => .error (.malformed "side")
  | "st_lane_marking", [r, sd, t, col] =>
    let m ← match sd with
      | .s "left" => pure (st_lane_marking_left s (← ent r))
      | .s "right" => pure (st_lane_marking_right s (← ent r))
      | _ => .error (.malformed "side")
    pure (R.and (eqEnum (m.map (·.1)) (← enumLit MarkingType.ofString t) name)
                (eqEnum (m.map (·.2)) (← enumLit MarkingColour.ofString col) name))
  | "st_lane_marking_left", [r, t] => pure (eqEnum ((st_lane_marking_left s (← ent r)).map (·.1)) (← enumLit MarkingType.ofString t) name)

  match k with
  | .s "x" => q (v.map (·.1)) name
  | .s "y" => q (v.map (·.2)) name

def evalMeasure (s : Scene) (name : String) (args : List DArg) : QR := do

    let e := kin_extent s (← ent x)

    | .s "length" => q (e.map fun (l, _, _) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) l) name
    | .s "width" => q (e.map fun (_, w, _) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) w) name
    | .s "height" => q (e.map fun (_, _, h) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) h) name
    | _ => .error (.malformed "extent")
  | "kin_steer_angle", [x] => q (kin_steer_angle s (← ent x)) name

  | "ru_electric_bicycle_class", [x] => qn (ru_electric_bicycle_class s (← ent x)) name
  | "st_lane_direction", [r, k] => comp ((st_lane_direction s (← ent r)).bind Geom.unit) k name
  | "st_lane_adjacency", [r, k] =>
    match k with
    | .s "ordinal" => qn (st_lane_adjacency_ordinal s (← ent r)) name
    | .s "count" => qn (st_lane_adjacency_count s (← ent r)) name
    | _ => .error (.malformed "adjacency field")
  | "st_lane_adjacency_ordinal", [r] => qn (st_lane_adjacency_ordinal s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_lane_adjacency_count", [r] => qn (st_lane_adjacency_count s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_lane_width", [r] => q (st_lane_width s (← ent r)) name

  | "st_grade", [r] => q (st_grade s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_sight_distance", [r] => q (st_sight_distance s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_sight_along_way", [x, w] => q (st_sight_along_way s (← ent x) (← ent w)) name
  | "st_parking_space_angle", [r] => q (st_parking_space_angle s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_region_geometry", [r, k] => comp (st_region_geometry_position s (← ent r)) k name
  | "st_region_geometry_distance", [x, r] => q (st_region_geometry_distance s (← ent x) (← ent r)) name
  | "dev_position", [d, k] => comp (dev_position s (← ent d)) k name

  | "env_civil_time", [k] =>
    let ct := env_civil_time s
    match k with
    | .s "minute_of_day" => qn (ct.map (·.minuteOfDay)) name
    | .s "weekday" => qn (ct.map (·.weekday)) name
    | .s "month" => qn (ct.map (·.month)) name
    | .s "day" => qn (ct.map (·.day)) name

/-- Whether a name is known to either table (the doctor holds this against `atomIds`). -/
def knowsAtom (n : String) : Bool :=
  let s : Scene := { t := 0 }
  let isUnknown : Except UnknownReason R → Bool
    | .error e => e == unknownAtom n
    | _ => false
  let isUnknownQ : QR → Bool
    | .error e => e == unknownAtom n
    | _ => false
  !(isUnknown (evalAtomE s n [] []) && isUnknownQ (evalMeasure s n []))

/-- The sort each entity argument of an atom must have (`none` marks a literal position): by
    family, with the mixed atoms listed. `none` for a name the tables do not know. -/
def atomArgSorts (name : String) : Option (List (Option EntityKind)) :=
  let t := some EntityKind.track; let r := some EntityKind.region; let d := some EntityKind.device
  match name with
  | "rel_occupies" => some [t, r]
  | "ru_aggregate" => some [t, none]
  | "dev_governs" => some [d, r]
  | "st_region_geometry_distance" | "st_sight_along_way" => some [t, r]
  | "st_lane_adjacency" => some [r, none, r]
  | "st_lane_adjacency_left" | "st_lane_adjacency_right" | "st_lane_connectivity" | "st_lane_enters" | "st_on_way"
  | "st_entrance_of" => some [r, r]
  | "st_lane_marking" => some [r, none, none, none]
  | "rel_oncoming" | "rel_same_direction" | "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" | "rel_ahead_in_lane"
  | "rel_behind_in_lane" | "rel_contact" | "rel_visible" | "rel_centre_distance" | "rel_longitudinal_overlap" => some [t, t]
  | "rel_surface_gap" | "rel_bearing" => some [t, t, none]
  | n =>
    if !knowsAtom n then none
    else if n.startsWith "env_" || n == "kin_time" then some []
    else if n.startsWith "ru_" || n.startsWith "kin_" || n.startsWith "sig_" then some [t, none, none]
    else if n.startsWith "st_" then some [r, none, none]
    else if n.startsWith "dev_" then some [d, none, none]
    else none

/-- The Lean name of an ATOMS.md id or attribute path (`dev.traffic_signal.shows` ↦ `dev_traffic_signal_shows`). -/
def defName (id : String) : String := id.replace "." "_"

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The evaluator: every subformula once, over the whole trace.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def constU (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : Array R := const n (R.u w)
def constE (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : Array QR := Array.replicate n (.error w)
def liftA (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array R)) : Array R :=
  match e with | .ok a => a | .error w => constU n w
def liftQ (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array QR)) : Array QR :=
  match e with | .ok a => a | .error w => constE n w
def qzip (f : Q → Q → Q) (a b : Array QR) : Array QR :=
  Array.zipWith (fun x y => do pure (f (← x) (← y))) a b

/-- A term that names no instant: a literal, a parameter or arithmetic over those. Only such a
    term may parametrize an atom or a derived concept. -/
partial def Term.isConstant : Term → Bool
  | .lit _ _ | .param _ => true
  | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => Term.isConstant a && Term.isConstant b
  | .neg a | .abs a => Term.isConstant a
  | _ => false

/-- The single value of a constant term's per-instant array. -/
def constOf (t : Term) (arr : Array QR) : Except UnknownReason Q := do
  if !Term.isConstant t then throw (.malformed "parameter is not a constant term")
  arr[0]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)

/-- The value of a heading change's step bound: a literal or a reading parameter, read as `constOf`
    reads a constant; any other term is malformed. -/
def stepOf (t : Term) (arr : Array QR) : Except UnknownReason Q :=
  match t with
  | .lit _ _ | .param _ => arr[0]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)
  | _ => .error (.malformed "heading_since step bound is not a literal or a reading parameter")

/-- The subject variable of a window: needed for path windows, irrelevant for time windows. -/
def subjectFor (β : Binding) (m : Measure) (v : String) : Except UnknownReason TrackId :=
  match m with
  | .time => .ok 0
  | .path => match β.track v with | some t => .ok t | none => .error (.unboundVariable v)

/-- Every region a quantifier over a kind ranges over in some scene of the trace: those whose
    membership of the kind is not false there (`regionCandidates`). -/
def regionsOf (c : SemCtx) (k : StructureKind) : List RegionId :=
  (c.scenes.toList.flatMap fun s => regionCandidates s k).eraseDups
def devicesOf (c : SemCtx) (k : DeviceKind) : List DeviceId :=
  (c.scenes.toList.flatMap fun s => deviceCandidates s k).eraseDups
/-- At each instant, whether the region is of the kind: true, false, or unknown where the source
    cannot tell the kind. A quantifier conjoins it with its body, so a region the source cannot
    place in the kind makes the quantifier unknown, never decided by its absence. -/
def regionIsKind (c : SemCtx) (r : RegionId) (k : StructureKind) : Array R :=
  c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (isKind s r k) (.absentAtom s!"st_{k}")
def deviceIsKind (c : SemCtx) (d : DeviceId) (k : DeviceKind) : Array R :=
  c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (devKind s d k) (.absentAtom s!"dev_{k}")
/-- Every road user present in some scene of the trace. -/
def usersOf (c : SemCtx) : List TrackId :=
  (c.scenes.toList.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups

/-- The kind a quantifier ranges over: a spelling of the ontology. A variable here is a concept's
    literal formal that no expansion filled. -/
def regionKindOf (a : Arg) : Except UnknownReason StructureKind :=
  match a with
  | .lit s => match StructureKind.ofString s with | some k => .ok k | none => .error (.malformed s!"region kind {s}")
  | .var v => .error (.malformed s!"region kind `{v}` is a variable")
  | .nat _ => .error (.malformed "region kind")
def deviceKindOf (a : Arg) : Except UnknownReason DeviceKind :=
  match a with
  | .lit s => match DeviceKind.ofString s with | some k => .ok k | none => .error (.malformed s!"device kind {s}")
  | .var v => .error (.malformed s!"device kind `{v}` is a variable")
  | .nat _ => .error (.malformed "device kind")

/-- φ where the precondition holds; undefined where it is false; the precondition's reasons where
    it is unknown. -/
def definedWhenR (pre x : R) : R :=
  match pre.v with
  | .t => x
  | .f => R.u (.undefined "defined_when")
  | .u => ⟨.u, pre.why⟩

/-- A selection at one instant: the branch the guard picks; where the guard is unknown, the
    branches' common value, else unknown with the guard's reasons. -/
def condAt (g : R) (a b : QR) : QR :=
  match g.v with
  | .t => a
  | .f => b
  | .u => match a, b with
    | .ok x, .ok y => if Q.eq x y then .ok x else .error (g.why.head?.getD (.malformed "cond"))
    | _, _ => .error (g.why.head?.getD (.malformed "cond"))

/-- An aggregate over the members present at one instant: unknown when a member's membership is
    unknown or a member's value is; `count` on an empty set is zero, the others are undefined. -/
def aggregateAt (op : AggOp) (xs : List (R × QR)) : QR :=
  match xs.find? (fun (f, _) => f.v == .u) with
  | some (f, _) => .error (f.why.head?.getD (.malformed "aggregate"))
  | none =>
    let vals := xs.filterMap fun (f, q) => if f.v == .t then some q else none
    match op with
    | .count => .ok (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat vals.length))
    | _ => do
      let qs ← vals.mapM fun q => q
      if qs.isEmpty then .error (.undefined "aggregate")
      else
        let sorted := qs.toArray.qsort (fun a b => Q.lt a b)
        match op with
        | .min => .ok sorted[0]!
        | .max => .ok sorted[sorted.size - 1]!
        | _ => .ok sorted[sorted.size / 2]!

/-- Membership of a road user in a legal aggregate at one scene: true when it carries an included
    class; unknown, with the observation's reason, when an included or unresolved class it might
    carry is unobserved; unknown as `aggregateUnresolved` when it carries a class the definition
    leaves unresolved; false otherwise. -/
def aggregateMembership (s : Scene) (t : TrackId) (a : LegalAggregate) : R :=
  let classes := fun (ids : List String) => ids.filterMap fun i => RoadUserClass.ofString (i.drop 3).toString
  match ru_aggregate s t (classes a.included) with
  | some true => R.t
  | none => R.u (.absentAtom "ru_aggregate")
  | some false =>
    match ru_aggregate s t (classes a.unresolved) with
    | some true => R.u (.aggregateUnresolved a.id)
    | some false => R.f
    | none => R.u (.absentAtom "ru_aggregate")

/-- Kleene aggregate at each instant over the evaluated members present in that scene. -/
def perScene (c : SemCtx) (evaluated : List (Nat × Array R))
    (presentIn : Scene → Nat → Bool) (agg : List R → R) : Array R :=
  (Array.range c.n).map fun i =>
    let s := c.scenes[i]!
    agg (evaluated.filterMap fun (m, arr) => if presentIn s m then some arr[i]! else none)

if Q.isZero d then .error (.divisionByZero "div") else pure (Q.div (← x) d)) (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
    | .neg a => (evalTAll c a).map (·.map Q.neg)
    | .abs a => (evalTAll c a).map (·.map Q.abs)
    | .cond φ a b' =>
      let g := evalAll c φ; let x := evalTAll c a; let y := evalTAll c b'
      (Array.range c.n).map fun i => condAt (g[i]?.getD (R.u .outOfRange)) (x[i]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)) (y[i]?.getD (.error .outOfRange))
  termination_by t => sizeOf t

  /-- Parameters of an atom or derived concept: constant terms, evaluated once. -/
  def constParams (c : SemCtx) : List Term → Except UnknownReason (List Q)
    | [] => .ok []
    | t :: rest => do
      let v ← constOf t (evalTAll c t)
      pure (v :: (← constParams c rest))
  termination_by ts => sizeOf ts

  def evalAll (c : SemCtx) : Formula → Array R
    | .tt => const c.n R.t
    | .ff => const c.n R.f
    | .atom name args ps =>
      liftA c.n do
        let vs ← constParams c ps
        let ds ← resolveAll c.β args
        if name == "ru_aggregate" then
          pure (match ds with
            | [.v t, .s id] =>
              match c.d.aggregateOverrides.find? (fun (x, a, _) => x == t && a == id) with
              | some (_, _, v) => const c.n (R.ofBool v)
              | none =>
                match c.d.ρ.aggregate id with
                | none => const c.n (R.u (.parameterMissing s!"aggregate:{id}"))
                | some a => c.scenes.map fun s => aggregateMembership s t a
            | _ => const c.n (R.u (.malformed "aggregate arguments")))
        else pure (c.scenes.map fun s => match evalAtomE s name ds vs with | .ok r => r | .error w => R.u w)
    | .cmp l op r => Array.zipWith (fun x y => match x, y with
        | .ok a, .ok b => R.ofBool (op.apply a b)
        | .error w, _ | _, .error w => R.u w) (evalTAll c l) (evalTAll c r)
    | .asm id => c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (s.assumption id) (.assumptionMissing id)
    | .intent id who target =>
      match who, target with
      | .var a, .var b =>
        match c.β.lookup a, c.β.lookup b with
        | some (.track x), some (.region r) => c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (s.intention id x r) (.intentionMissing id)
        | none, _ => constU c.n (.unboundVariable a)
        | _, none => constU c.n (.unboundVariable b)
        | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "intent: a track and a region expected")
      | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "intent: a track and a region expected")
    | .same a b =>
      match resolve c.β a, resolve c.β b with
      | .ok (.v i), .ok (.v j) => const c.n (R.ofBool (i == j))
      | .error w, _ | _, .error w => constU c.n w
      | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "same: entities expected")
    | .not φ => mapNot (evalAll c φ)
    -- a connective whose left operand settles it at every instant does not evaluate its right one
    | .and φ ψ =>
      let a := evalAll c φ
      if a.all (·.v == .f) then a.map (fun _ => R.f) else zipAnd a (evalAll c ψ)
    | .or φ ψ =>
      let a := evalAll c φ
      if a.all (·.v == .t) then a.map (fun _ => R.t) else zipOr a (evalAll c ψ)
    | .implies φ ψ =>
      let a := evalAll c φ
      if a.all (·.v == .f) then a.map (fun _ => R.t) else zipImplies a (evalAll c ψ)
    | .always φ => alwaysAll (evalAll c φ)
    | .eventually φ => eventuallyAll (evalAll c φ)
    | .until φ ψ => untilAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ)
    | .since φ ψ => sinceAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ)
    | .holdsFor m d subj φ =>
      liftA c.n do
        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
        pure (holdsForAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "holdsFor" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ))
    | .within m d subj φ =>
      liftA c.n do
        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
        pure (withinAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "within" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ))
    | .untilWithin m d subj φ ψ =>
      liftA c.n do
        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
        pure (untilWithinAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "untilWithin" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ))
    | .atLast m d subj ψ φ =>
      liftA c.n do
        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
        pure (atLastAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "atLast" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c ψ) (evalAll c φ))
    | .count edge sinceφ op k =>
      (countEdgesAll "count" (evalAll c edge) (evalAll c sinceφ)).map fun e => match e with
        | .error w => R.u w
        | .ok m => R.ofBool (op.apply (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat m)) (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)))
    | .rises φ => risesAll (evalAll c φ)
    | .definedWhen pre φ => Array.zipWith definedWhenR (evalAll c pre) (evalAll c φ)
    | .derived concept args ps =>
      liftA c.n do
        let vs ← constParams c ps
        Primitives.evalB concept c.d (← resolveAll c.β args) vs
    | .rule id map =>
      let arr := c.compose id map c.β false
      if arr.size = c.n then arr else constU c.n (.compositionUnknown id)
    | .ruleApplies id map =>
      let arr := c.compose id map c.β true
      if arr.size = c.n then arr else constU c.n (.compositionUnknown id)
    | .existsUser v φ =>
      perScene c ((usersOf c).map fun t => (t, evalAll (c.bindVar v (.track t)) φ))
        (fun s t => s.tracks.contains t) R.any
    | .forallUser v φ =>
      perScene c ((usersOf c).map fun t => (t, evalAll (c.bindVar v (.track t)) φ))
        (fun s t => s.tracks.contains t) R.all
    | .existsRegion k v φ =>
      match regionKindOf k with
      | .error w => constU c.n w
      | .ok kd => perScene c ((regionsOf c kd).map fun r =>
            (r, Array.zipWith R.and (regionIsKind c r kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.region r)) φ)))
          (fun s r => (s.structure? r).isSome) R.any
    | .forallRegion k v φ =>
      match regionKindOf k with
      | .error w => constU c.n w
      | .ok kd => perScene c ((regionsOf c kd).map fun r =>
            (r, Array.zipWith R.implies (regionIsKind c r kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.region r)) φ)))
          (fun s r => (s.structure? r).isSome) R.all
    | .existsDevice k v φ =>
      match deviceKindOf k with
      | .error w => constU c.n w
      | .ok kd => perScene c ((devicesOf c kd).map fun d =>
            (d, Array.zipWith R.and (deviceIsKind c d kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.device d)) φ)))
          (fun s d => (s.device d).isSome) R.any
    | .forallDevice k v φ =>
      match deviceKindOf k with
      | .error w => constU c.n w
      | .ok kd => perScene c ((devicesOf c kd).map fun d =>
            (d, Array.zipWith R.implies (deviceIsKind c d kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.device d)) φ)))
          (fun s d => (s.device d).isSome) R.all
  termination_by φ => sizeOf φ
end

/-- The value of a formula at instant `i`. -/
def eval (c : SemCtx) (i : Nat) (φ : Formula) : R := (evalAll c φ)[i]?.getD (R.u .outOfRange)
def evalTri (c : SemCtx) (i : Nat) (φ : Formula) : Tri := (eval c i φ).v
